neckLift.heroSubtitle: Restore a Defined Jawline and a Youthful Neck Contour
neckLift.heroDesc1: The neck often reveals age earlier than the face. Skin laxity, vertical muscle bands, and loss of jawline definition can create a heavy or aged appearance even when the face itself looks relatively youthful.
neckLift.heroDesc2: A neck lift, medically referred to as cervicoplasty or platysmaplasty, is a surgical procedure designed to tighten neck muscles, remove excess skin, and redefine the jawline for a smoother, more youthful contour.
neckLift.whatIsDesc1: A neck lift is a surgical procedure that improves visible signs of ageing in the neck and jawline. Clinical studies indexed on PubMed support that platysma muscle repair and structural neck lifting provide longer-lasting and more natural results than skin tightening alone.
neckLift.whatIsDesc2: A neck lift is not a fat-removal-only procedure. Structural correction is essential for durable outcomes.
neckLift.keyPoint3: Defining the jawline and chin–neck angle
neckLift.howItWorksDesc: Neck lift surgery focuses on rebuilding the underlying framework of the neck. The surgery is performed under general anaesthesia in a hospital setting.
neckLift.step0: Small incisions behind the ears and under the chin
neckLift.step1: Tightening and repositioning of the platysma muscles
neckLift.step3: Refinement of neck contour and jawline
neckLift.step4: Careful closure to minimise visible scarring
neckLift.howItWorksNote: International clinical authorities such as the Mayo Clinic and the American Society of Plastic Surgeons recognise modern neck lift techniques as safe and effective for correcting neck ageing and jawline blurring.
neckLift.typesDesc: The appropriate technique is selected based on anatomy and ageing pattern.
neckLift.type0Desc: Focuses on removing excess neck skin for a smoother contour.
neckLift.type1Desc: Tightens the neck muscles to correct banding and restore definition.
neckLift.type2Desc: Removes excess fat while tightening skin and muscle for enhanced results.
neckLift.type3Desc: Combines facial and neck rejuvenation for balanced, comprehensive results.
neckLift.benefitsDesc: A neck lift refines what gravity has blurred.
neckLift.benefit5: Can be combined with facial rejuvenation procedures
neckLift.candidateDesc: Mild cases may benefit from non-surgical treatments, while moderate to advanced laxity requires surgical correction. Ideal candidates typically:
neckLift.candidate0: Have loose or sagging neck skin
neckLift.candidate1: Notice jawline blurring or neck banding
neckLift.timeline1Desc: Improved comfort, return to light activities
neckLift.timeline3Desc: Final contour as tissues fully settle
neckLift.recoveryNote: Postoperative care follows internationally accepted surgical recovery standards outlined by the World Health Organization.
neckLift.comparisonDesc: Non-surgical treatments can complement surgery but cannot replicate its results.
neckLift.pricingDesc: Neck lift surgery cost varies depending on:
neckLift.pricing0: Type of neck lift technique selected
neckLift.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about neck lift surgery
neckLift.faq0A: A neck lift is surgery that tightens neck muscles and skin to restore a youthful neck and jawline.
neckLift.faq1Q: Will a neck lift look natural?
neckLift.faq1A: Yes, when performed using modern techniques, results are natural and balanced.
neckLift.faq2Q: How long do neck lift results last?
neckLift.faq2A: Results typically last many years, depending on ageing and lifestyle factors.
neckLift.faq3A: Discomfort is usually mild to moderate and well controlled with medication.
neckLift.faq4A: Scars are discreetly placed behind the ears and under the chin.
neckLift.faq5Q: How long is recovery after a neck lift?
neckLift.faq5A: Most patients return to normal activities within 2–3 weeks.
neckLift.faq6Q: Can a neck lift be combined with a face lift?
neckLift.faq6A: Yes, it is commonly combined for comprehensive rejuvenation.
neckLift.faq7Q: Is neck lift surgery safe in Malaysia?
neckLift.faq7A: Yes, when performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a licensed facility.
neckLift.ctaDesc1: Restore definition, balance, and confidence with surgeon-performed neck lift surgery in Malaysia.
neckLift.ctaDesc2: When the neck is rejuvenated with precision, the face finally looks complete.
